notes.title: Update to Address Game Crashing Issues - June 12 (Thu)
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.[/p][p][/p][p]We have confirmed that the game could crash under the following specific conditions.[/p][p]An update to mitigate these issues has now been applied.[/p][list][*][p]A potential crash that could occur when using NVIDIA graphics cards[/p][/*][*][p]A potential crash related to the on-screen guide when certain conditions are met[/p][/*][*][p]A potential crash that could occur during the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p]Please restart the game to apply the update.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any other issues while playing, please report them through the [b]#|game-feedback[/b] channel on our official Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: How to Check and Install a Supported Graphics Driver Version
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.[/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in our previous announcement and FAQ, we’ve identified crash issues related to certain graphics driver versions. Since the start of the Alpha Test, we’ve received a notable number of crash reports related to this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]In particular, crashes have been observed specifically with NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576. We kindly ask you to download and use version 572 or earlier, as previously advised.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the instructions below to check your current graphics driver version and download a supported version.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Check Your NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version[/b][/p][p]1) Open the NVIDIA App from the icon in your Windows taskbar.[/p][p](You can also check the version through NVIDIA Control Panel or GeForce Experience.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/2565e3e555d403091f687dfe7e57a56ef95cccc5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]2) Check your driver version:[/p][p]- You can find this under System > My Rig in the NVIDIA App.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/5c3104dd7414d2f19d6c9171f4592b358cba313e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Download NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version 572 or Earlier[/b][/p][p]If you are currently using NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576, the game may crash during launch. A driver version lower than 576 is required.[/p][p]We recommend installing version 572 or earlier by following the steps below.[/p][p][/p][p]1) Uninstall the current driver (version 576.XX) from your PC.[/p][p][/p][p]2) Visit the official NVIDIA website and enter your graphics card details to search for available drivers. \[Go to NVIDIA Driver Search]([url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/"]https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/[/url])[/p][p][/p][p]3) Download driver version lower than 572[/p][p]We recommend that you download 572.XX versions such as below from the results.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/254b29332cda88172f03e5a740a6765e8f4dd7c6.png"][/img][/p][p]If you encounter any further bugs or technical problems, please report them through the #｜game-feedback channel on our official Discord server.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: (UPDATE) Known Issues
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Mercenaries,  [/h3]

Below are Known Issues during the pre-alpha test. 


[h3]■ 3/14(Thu.) Known Issues  [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cannot start the game while using certain AMD Radeon series graphics cards.[/b]
[/list][strike][quote=]Please follow the initial workaround steps below for this issue:
[olist]
[*] Right Click Vindictus: Defying Fate Playtest on Steam Launcher
[*] Click [Properties]
[*] Go to [General] and type -dx11 in [LAUNCH OPTIONS]
[/olist]
Please note that frame rate drops or crashes may occur depending on the type of graphics card after following the workaround above.[/quote][/strike]

[list]
[*] [b]Crash upon launching with a pop-up saying 'Please install the latest driver version or switch to a different rendering API.'[/b]
[/list][quote=]Please update your Graphics Driver to the latest version to resolve this issue.[/quote]

[list]
[*] [b]An intermittent issue where the game freezes during the network connection. (NEW)[/b]
[/list][quote=]You may play the game normally by restarting the game from the Steam Library from 3/13 8:52 PM PDT.[/quote]

[list]
[*] [b]An issue where [Camera Control: Vertical] and [Camera Control: Horizontal] - [Inverted] is not being reflected, when applied from [Title > Settings]. (NEW)[/b]
[/list][quote=]Settings will be reflected normally if it's applied during the gameplay.[/quote]

Our developers are currently working to identify and resolve the cause of the issues, and we will make every effort to resolve them. 

[i]Please understand the issues may not be addressed during the pre-alpha test period.  [/i]


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.
